subtitle: Lesson 52 · MySQL Performance Tuning

code:
SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'innodb_buffer_pool_size';

[mysqld]
innodb_buffer_pool_size = 8G

# rough guideline: ~70-80% of RAM
# on a dedicated DB server
caption: MySQL's single most impactful setting — same idea as SQL Server's buffer pool.

code:
Too small: more frequent dirty-page flushing
Too large: slower crash recovery
  (more redo log to replay)

Size it against your actual write workload
caption: A real tradeoff, not a setting to maximize blindly.
Each connection carries memory overhead — too high risks memory pressure.
